name: MONSE
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $625 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's deconstructed tailoring, shirting, knits, dresses and eveningwear, mostly $600–$2,400, sold through its own site, a New York boutique and Saks.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 2015 by Laura Kim; Fernando Garcia.

quote.q: Rooted in craft and shaped by contrast, the brand reimagines the familiar - where structure meets spontaneity, and confidence is worn without compromise.

opview: “Rooted in craft and shaped by contrast, the brand reimagines the familiar - where structure meets spontaneity, and confidence is worn without compromise.” — MONSE (house), Our Story, monse.com

facts_read.source: brand site (our story, SS27 lookbook, FW26 collection, boutique, terms); Fashionista 2015-09-29; saksfifthavenue.com brand page; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer index (2026-10-13 list); B Lab directory; GOTS database

Trousers.hp: Deconstructed Tailored Lace Hem Skirt Trouser

price_read.sublines: MONSE women's ready-to-wear; EXCLUDED: Sperry x MONSE shoes (collaboration), handbags, accessories, archive and sale

doors.note: One boutique/atelier at 15 Rivington St (appointments offered). Page gives street only — no city/state/ZIP published; New York NY inferred from brand context.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 141 clothing styles (197 feed records less accessories, handbags, shoes, gift card = 153 listings, collapsed on title); composition f

craft_evidence.owned: claimed, not located — one PDP (Tie Dress) says 'Crafted in our in-house atelier'; no address or city
craft_evidence.madein: ~95% state a country (76 of 80): USA 38, China 34, Turkey 3
craft_evidence.heritage: founders named (Laura Kim, Fernando Garcia); 'Designed in New York'; no making place
craft_evidence.reasoning: Country of making is stated on nearly every product page, split about half USA and half China, and one page claims an in-house atelier without saying where. No maker, mill or process is named. A stated country across the range with an unlocated atelier claim is a 2.
